About

Keeping streams
alive when it
matters most.

I'm a Broadcast & Linux Engineer based in Chennai, working at the intersection of live TV operations and server infrastructure.

Over the years I've built and maintained Ubuntu-based streaming pipelines handling live sports — La Liga, NBA, NFL, Wimbledon — managing everything from satellite downlink and playout scheduling to FFmpeg encoding and SRT/RTMP delivery.

I've deployed and managed cloud infrastructure on DigitalOcean, OVH, and Proxmox, and I've run 24×7 production environments where stream quality isn't optional.
